text:
Maya: Quick sync — finalizing the staggered send plan for the launch newsletter. Need to avoid APAC/EMEA/US overlap and keep IP warm-up under control. Draft schedule + segment counts in the sheet: https://docs.google.com/sheets/d/1LaunchDraft

Jules: Can we confirm segments? I thought we were doing: seed (early adopters), warm (active trial users), cold (newsletter-only). sizes?

Maya: Yep — seed=4,200, warm=38,000, cold=112,000. Seed goes first for validation, warm next with 2 subject variants, cold slowly over 48h window.

Ben: Subject line ideas (2 quick):
- "See how Redwood cuts inference cost by 3x"
- "Reduce latency, not your engineering velocity"

Marisol: For body copy: we'll use the launch narrative + one contextual paragraph for each segment (seed gets roadmap CTA, warm gets case study highlight, cold gets product TL;DR). I'll prep 3 variations by EOD.

Jules: A/B plan: seed gets 2 subjects and 1 CTA test. Warm gets 2 subject lines only. Cold is control-only for deliverability baseline. Should we include an image for warm? Ben: yes but keep it lightweight (SVG snapshot).

Arun: Operational constraints: our dedicated throttle is 20k/hour for hosted sends to keep reputation steady. For cold cohort we need to chunk into 3 waves across 48h. Also recommend ramping: 10% / 30% / 60% over first 12h for warm.

Maya: Good call on ramping. Also need to schedule sends by timezone local hour preference: APAC between 10:00–14:00 local, EMEA 09:00–11:00 local, US 13:00–16:00 local.

Jules: Can we map segments to those windows automatically? We have timezone field in the DB but some users lack tz — fallback to inferred country. I'll export and share mapping in 15m.

Marisol: Small copy change for seed: swap CTA to "Join roadmap preview" and add a short ask to join feedback session. Tone: more technical.

Ben: Quick preview screenshots attached in the sheet. Keep preheader under 90 chars. Propose preheader: "New cost/perf tradeoffs for shipping LLM features"

Maya: Delivery QA checklist before send:
- seed: test sends to internal seed list (team + 20 users)
- warm: inbox preview + Gmail/Outlook screenshots
- cold: run domain check and seed-only warmup wave
- suppressions: opt-outs, hard bounces, and support tickets last 72h

Arun: I'll run the warmup plan on the SMTP side. Command to run the staged send is below:
```
send-tool --env prod --campaign launch_newsletter_2026 --wave 1 --limit 4200
send-tool --env prod --campaign launch_newsletter_2026 --wave 2 --limit 38000
```
I'll also monitor bounce rate and pause if >1.5% in any 1h window.

Maya: Who's owning the post-send metrics dashboard? Need open rate, click rate, spam complaints, CTA conversions, and region breakdown.

Jules: I'll own the dashboard and alerting. Trigger email to #marketing if CTR < 1% after 24h or complaint rate >0.05%.

Marisol: Minor: for cold cohort subject we should avoid words flagged by spam filters. I'm removing "free" and "guarantee" from variants.

Ben: Final ask: include an accessible plain-text version. Also test dark-mode rendering for images.

send-scheduler-bot: Scheduled waves created:
- wave_seed: ts=1775560000, recipients=4200, subject_variant=A/B
- wave_warm_wave1: ts=1775580000, recipients=38000, ramp=10/30/60
- wave_cold_start: ts=1775605000, recipients=112000, window=48h

Maya: Perfect. Next steps: Marisol finalize copy by 18:00 PT, Ben finish assets by 16:00 PT, Arun run warmup tonight, Jules publish dashboard + upload mapping. We'll regroup post-send for learnings. :thumbsup:
